text:
Ivy K: quick follow-up from the midnight postmortem — collecting owners + short, testable PRs to reduce recurring pages and make remediation timelines explicit.
Owen B: saw the same error flood across three paging tiers; our paging policy escalated too fast because thresholds don't account for bursty retries.
Sofia M: noted. doc with timeline + curl traces: https://redwood.internal/pm/alerts-retro-3005. pattern: transient retry storm + per-instance fingerprints + short dedupe window.
Ivy K: suggested action list (tiny, concrete):
  1) Implement tiered paging delays: immediate page only for severity=critical, otherwise add 5m soft-delay before paging secondary on-call. owner: Owen B. ETA: 72h.
  2) Normalize dedupe fingerprint to stable keys (service, route, error_class) and remove ephemeral ids. extend dedupe window to 3m. owner: Sofia M. ETA: 4 days.
  3) Add "suppression-candidate" workflow: weekly job that lists alerts fired >=5 times/24h and creates a board card for manual review (no auto-suppress). owner: Nate R. ETA: 10 days.
Ivy K: also propose a small observability piece: add metric duplicate_alerts_ratio and a dashboard tile so we can watch grouping impact post-change. owner: Owen B. ETA: 1 week.
Owen B: ack. for (1) I'll open the paging-policy PR with unit tests and an e2e replay against the incident traffic pattern. sample config snippet: ```yaml
paging_policy:
  tiers:
    - severity: critical
      immediate: true
    - severity: warning
      soft_delay_seconds: 300
```
Sofia M: ack. for (2) I'll add a feature-flagged rollout and tests ensuring cross-region grouping for identical root_cause hashes. pseudo: ```json
{
  "dedupe_window_seconds": 180,
  "fingerprint_keys": ["service","route","error_class"]
}
```
Nate R: ack. for (3) suppression-candidate job will post to #alerts-review and create a Trello card in the postmortem board. will include reviewer gating and an opt-in auto-suppress flow only after 2 approvals.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT-90012 resolved. Please assign follow-up owners and attach to the incident.
Ivy K: safety/rollback guard: emit an "excess_suppression" alert if suppressed pages >15% of total in 24h. owner: Sofia M. ETA: 1 week.
Owen B: I'll add the duplicate_alerts_ratio metric and a simple regression alert if dedupe reduces pages but latency or error-rate rises.
Sofia M: created branch: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-normalize-3m  feature-flagged, adding unit tests.
Nate R: suppression job PR: https://git.redwood/ops/pull/621  cron + board integration + reviewer flow.
Owen B: paging policy PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pull/884  includes replay test + runbook.
Ivy K: scheduling a 15m sync in 48h to validate PRs land and test replays. also adding owners and explicit due dates to the postmortem board.
Sofia M: optional canary: start suppression review on dev/staging alerts for 72h before enabling prod. owner: Nate R. ETA: 2 weeks.
Ivy K: thanks all. please post PR links to the board and close this thread once cards are created. :white_check_mark:
Owen B: PRs opened and tests running. will update the board after merge.
Nate R: job merged to staging, will monitor first weekly run and post the candidate list.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: weekly alert-cleanup sweep scheduled Fridays 09:00 UTC.
Ivy K: closing for now; reopen if we see regressions after the canary.
